title: Fourth moment of a coordinate derivative
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, and let $F$ be a multilinear coefficient family of degree at most $k+1$. Fix a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ be independent under $\mu$, each satisfying the fourth-order invariance moment conditions. The fourth moment of the random-input evaluation of the coefficient family of the Boolean-cube derivative of $F$ in coordinate $i$ is at most $9^k\mathrm{Inf}_i[F]^2$.
